caption: The drawing depicts a single long purple dress with a textured, scalloped and layered appearance. The dress is buttoned down the front with dark buttons, extending from the high lace-trimmed collar to the lower part of the bodice. Both the collar and the cuffs of the long sleeves are decorated with white lace. The sleeves are closely fitted down to ruffled, flared lace cuffs at the wrists. The skirt is voluminous and features multiple layers of overlapping, petal-shaped fabric pieces, each edged with fine lines to create the illusion of texture and depth. The dress is unadorned by any visible embellishments apart from the lace and buttons. The background is plain, off-white, and there is no figure wearing the dress, so it appears floating or empty. No additional objects are present in the drawing.
title: Doll's Dress
